text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued February 9, 2019, Appeal DDRT2019-13

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Rescinded the determination of a dangerous dog, exempted the applicant from compliance with the Dangerous Dog Order issued February 9, 2019, and directed that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Sarah Soobram and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before October 2, 2019.
